item.description:
Pauses read as pauses. A full stop before a word that cannot start a sentence — which, because, such as, as soon as — is now treated as the pause it was, in every mode: "I have some ID. Which completes the check" comes through as one sentence.

Your dictionary wins. Corrections you have taught it are applied before the cleanup model sees the text, so a mishearing can no longer be rewritten into a different word on the way through. The technical dictionaries no longer capitalise ordinary words: the rest of the team, a police raid and write down the number come through as you said them. "New line" and "new paragraph" keep the punctuation before them.

Quieter, lighter. Messages the app shows outside a dictation — a trial that has ended, a redraft in progress — now appear. The shortcuts that take back or redraft the last insertion go quiet two minutes after it, or when you switch apps, so they can never backspace into other text. Long dictations in Clean no longer wait through two timeouts. Enhanced Clean loads its model without contacting the internet once downloaded, and holds about 750 MB less memory while loaded. Copies with a licence are no longer subject to the test-build expiry date.

Missed a release? 0.18.1 fixed a blank words-per-minute figure for anyone with Record dictations off. 0.18.0 put right a fortnight of real dictation (postcodes, spoken amounts, email addresses), kept your opening Yes or No in Draft and Prompt, and added the Statistics row. 0.17.12 gave Clean a second chance at pause-broken sentences, added a Permaculture dictionary, and turned update checks on by default. Every release, in order: github.com/romeo-golf-software/dictation-releases/releases.
